name: LAND33
recent: LAND33 近期通过 ESOS 发行新股，并有一名高管在闭市期间表示有意交易股份。公司也发布了截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩报告。
notable: 通过 ESOS 发行 2,376,600 股新股，发行价每股 RM0.2368，上市日期为 2026 年 11 月 27 日。
公司高管 Ooi Soon Hong 在闭市期间表示有意交易股份，其视为权益持股为 77,176,581 股（21.512%）。
risks: ESOS 新股发行可能对现有股东造成股权摊薄。
高管在闭市期间表示有意交易股份，可能引发市场对内部人交易的关注。

DEALINGS IN LISTED SECURITIES (CHAPTER 14 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : Intention to Deal During Closed Period

recent_en: LAND33 recently issued new shares under its ESOS and a senior officer indicated intention to deal in shares during the closed period. The company also released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
notable_en: Issued 2,376,600 new shares under ESOS at RM0.2368 per share, with listing date on 27 November 2026.
Senior officer Ooi Soon Hong indicated intention to deal in shares during closed period, with deemed interest of 77,176,581 shares (21.512%).
risks_en: The ESOS new share issuance may dilute existing shareholders' equity.
The senior officer's intention to deal during closed period may raise market attention on insider trading.
